title: A little put off by how little you get.
text:
A little put off by how little you get.. I'm a little bewildered why -ash- costs so much for so little. I understand quality, but this is a bit ridiculous. It's ash. Pictured: my medium-sized lady hand beside the bag. Bag is about 1.4 cm thick.

On the plus side, it is as advertised and very soft and powdery.
